summary: Current main already contains upstream PR #30393's issue-specific packed HiCache draft-cache design. Standard NextN EAGLE draft pools, including GLM-5.x, are appended to the target host pool and transferred in one operation, so the separate mem_pool_host_draft backup call that failed in v0.5.15.post1 no longer exists. No further production change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Current direct-backup K/V dispatch, asymmetric K/V boundary behavior, and page_first/page_first_direct host-registration granularity; 20 tests and 12 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-fe1e6648cfb7/unit_tests.log

Real gfx950 direct all-layer D2H transfers for MHA and MLA at page size 64, compared against independent PyTorch indexed-copy references; 2 passed. Raw output: reports/j-fe1e6648cfb7/gpu_direct_transfer.log

gpu_evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported one AMD Instinct MI355X with capability (9, 5); the two real sgl_kernel direct-transfer numerical tests passed. Raw environment: reports/j-fe1e6648cfb7/environment.log
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA CUDA device was available, so the reported cudaMemcpyBatchAsync failure itself was not executed.
GLM-5.2-FP8 and EAGLE draft weights were unavailable.
The environment has one gfx950 GPU, not the reported TP8 prefill and TP8 decode nodes.
Mooncake/RDMA and the two-node PD serving topology were not reproduced.
The GPU fixture validates the direct transfer primitive, not GLM semantic accuracy or distributed serving.
